title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: You're up $2,000 on a trade, then it

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: drops to 1,000 and suddenly all you can

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: think is that was my mortgage payment.

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: So, you panic and sell. The trade was

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: still working perfectly. You broke it.

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: And today, I'm going to show you exactly

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: why that keeps happening and how to fix

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: it. The shift that separates amateur

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: traders from professionals isn't a new

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: indicator or a secret strategy. It's

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: learning to think at the portfolio level

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: instead of the individual trade level.

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: That one change affects how you size

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: positions, how you hedge, and how you

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: read the market you're actually in, not

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: the one you wish you were trading. Let's

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: get into it. Here's what most traders

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: do. They open a position, and then they

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: stare at it. Every tick up feels like

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: genius. Every tick down feels like a

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: personal attack, and all of their

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: decision-making gets hijacked by one

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: number on a screen. The market doesn't

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: know your mortgage payment exists. It

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: doesn't care about your cost basis. When

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: you attach a personal dollar, meaning to

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: an unrealized gain or loss, you're no

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: longer trading the chart. You're trading

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: your emotions. Now, imagine tracking 50

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: trades at once instead of one. What what

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: happens to the emotional weight of any

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: single position? It shrinks

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: dramatically. You stop asking, did I

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: manage that trade perfectly? And you

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: start asking, how did I manage all of

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: them? And what does the aggregate look

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: like? That's exactly how professionals

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: think. Trading is a probabilities game

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: played over hundreds of repetitions, not

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: a series of individual high stakes

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: moments. And the sooner you internalize

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: that, the cleaner your decisions become.

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: Here's where most traders are making a

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: silent, costly mistake. Right now,

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: they're still running a portfolio built

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: for a market that no longer exists. For

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: the past 2 to three years, the market

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: rewarded a heavily long tech

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: concentrated approach. 80 or even 90%

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: long made sense. That environment is

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: gone. Right now, roughly 50% of all

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: stocks are above their 50-day moving

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: average and 50% are below. The market is

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: telling you something directly. Your

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: portfolio composition should reflect

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: that reality. If you're running 90% long

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: in a 50/50 market, you're not reading

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: the environment, you're fighting it. A

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: roughly balanced mix of long and short

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: exposure isn't pessimism. It's

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: alignment. Think of it this way.

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: Portfolio composition is the primary

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: decision. Individual trade selection

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: happens within that framework. Get the

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: composition wrong and even great

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: individual setups won't save you. In

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: what traders call a barbell market on

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: one end, utilities, energy, industrials,

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: basic materials, these are working on

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: the other end. Tech, AI names, consumer

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: discretionary, these are struggling. The

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: S&P 500 has gone sideways since October,

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: but the equal weight S&P is trending

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: higher. That tells you money isn't

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: leaving equities, it's rotating. So on

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: the long side, the unsexy sectors are

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: leading. Pull up XLU or XLP utilities

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: and consumer staples. Then go inside

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: those ETFs and find the individual names

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: whose charts look even better than the

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: ETF itself. That's where you want to be.

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: On the short side, don't just buy puts

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: on weak tech names in a sideways market

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: that it will bleed you dry while the

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: stock grinds nowhere. Instead, look at

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: credit spreads. Selling out of the money

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: call spreads on the weakest names lets

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: you profit. If the stock stays flat,

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: drifts lower, or even rises slightly,

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: it's a high probability limited risk

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: trade built perfectly for this

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: environment. Let's talk hedging because

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: most people either skip it entirely or

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: misunderstand what it's for. A hedge is

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: insurance and insurance is supposed to

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: cost you money most of the time. If your

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: hedge is making money, something bad

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: happened to your portfolio that it

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: offset. That's the whole point. Here's a

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: simple sizing framework. Say you have a

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: $100,000 portfolio. You don't want to

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: hedge all of it because if the market

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: recovers, your hedge loses money while

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: your positions recover and the cost eats

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: into your gains unnecessarily. Target 30

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: to 50% coverage instead. Use delta to

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: size it. NASDAQ is around $600 a share.

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: One put contract with a delta of 50

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: hedges, roughly $30,000 of exposure,

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: about 30% of your portfolio. That's a

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: sensible starting point. When markets

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: start rolling over, here's the sequence.

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: Put the hedge on immediately before

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: panic sets in. Then let your long

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: positions get stopped out naturally.

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: Don't force exits. Once the picture

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: clarifies, take the hedge off and

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: redeploy into direct short positions or

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: bearish spreads. The hedge buys you

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: something you can't put a price on. Time

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: and clarity. Without it, fear drives the

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: bus and traders make reactive decisions

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: that compound losses long after the

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: initial drop. Here's the bottom line.

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: Stop measuring yourself trade by trade.

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: Build a process. Run it across 50 or

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: more trades and let the aggregate

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: results tell you whether it's working.

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: Match your portfolio composition to what

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: the market is actually doing right now.

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: Size your hedges before you need them.

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: And zoom out. The market rewards traders

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: who think in systems, not the ones

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: staring at a single position hoping it

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: saves their month. If this helped, hit

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: like and subscribe and drop a comment.

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: Are you more guilty of individual trade

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: obsession or are you still running last

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: year's portfolio in this year's market?

title: Portfolio Thinking: The #1 Shift That Separates Pro Traders
text: See you in the next one.
